data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Mabkhut" represents the desire to be cherished and adored by Allah (God) and to cherish and serve Him wholeheartedly in return. It is a reminder of the importance of being loved by Allah and striving for His pleasure above all else. Additionally, it can also symbolize the belief that every human being is precious and beloved by Allah, deserving of love, kindness, and respect.
